request:
镜头 s26：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：特写，固定，资料影像质感。一只只手把实体钥匙卡一张接一张放进红色镜头下的钢托盘里，托盘越堆越满。环境声：卡片落进托盘的清脆声、大厅的回声。
情绪：ceremonial, cold, irreversible
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, locked-off archival camera
景深与虚实：Archival softness; the cards in focus, the red lens a blurred glow above.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival close-up in the handover hall: gloved and bare hands lay plain physical access key cards one after another into a steel tray beneath the glowing red lens; the tray is filling up. The cards are blank, no text. Blocking lock: the steel tray sits at frame lower centre, hands enter from left and right, the red lens glows soft at the top of frame.
Picture 2: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
Picture 3: the 2058 handover hall of the global network authority (location reference; role: location reference). A vast, solemn control hall of the 2058 global network authority: tiered empty rows facing a colossal black monolithic terminal wall with a single huge round red-glowing lens at its centre, in the design of the reference terminal; cold white light, a polished floor reflecting the red lens. Empty of people.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：crisp clatter of cards on steel, hall echo
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, close-up, locked-off archival ENG camera on a tripod with no camera move, only a faint focus breathing as the hands come near; framing held tightly on the steel tray at the bottom of frame with the red lens a soft glow at the top. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: steel tray at frame lower centre already holding a thin layer of cards, a bare hand entering from frame left, a gloved hand entering from frame right, the blurred red lens at the top of frame, everything behind crushed into murky shadow. Start: the bare hand from frame left tilts and lets a blank key card drop flat onto the tray with a small bounce, the fingers still pinching the corner before letting go. Middle: the hands alternate faster, two or three cards in quick succession from frame right, the tray filling up, cards sliding and settling at slightly crossed angles, one card skidding to the tray rim and being nudged back in by a gloved fingertip; the stack rises and the topmost cards begin to lie uneven. End: one last card is laid on the heap, the hand pauses with fingertips resting on it for an instant and then withdraws past the frame right edge, leaving the tray heaped almost to overflowing, the pile trembling once and going still. Mood: ceremonial, cold, irreversible. Blur: the cards and the steel tray rim stay sharp; the red lens above dissolves into a soft red glow with a faint halo of chroma smear, and the far background is a murky unreadable dark. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Crisp clatter of thin cards dropping onto steel, cards sliding and settling against each other, a gloved fingertip tapping the tray rim, faint rustle of fabric from the sleeves, low hall echo with a long tail off the far stone walls, distant steady room hum; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
